label: Tavern Confrontation (default)
description: Eight-panel sample scene designed to stress different aspects of an image model: wide establishing shots, close-ups, action, group shots with character consistency, and prop interaction.
default_style_template: Muted ink-wash painterly comic, limited palette of warm umbers and cool slates, heavy black line work with selective halftone shading, cinematic lighting, mid-century European comic aesthetic, paper-textured background.

reference_images.label: Anya — protagonist (dark hair, leather coat, scar across left eyebrow)
The Iron Lantern Tavern — dim, low-ceilinged, oak beams, hanging lanterns

panels.label: Wide establishing — exterior tavern at dusk
panels.prompt: Wide establishing shot of the Iron Lantern Tavern at dusk. Cobblestone street wet with rain, warm lantern light spilling from the windows onto the stones. Hanging wooden sign creaks above the doorway. No people visible. Cinematic wide-angle, low camera, dramatic chiaroscuro.

panels.label: Single-character close-up — Anya, neutral
panels.prompt: Close-up portrait of Anya, framed from the shoulders up, neutral expression, eyes scanning off-camera to her left. Dim tavern light catches her scarred eyebrow and the worn leather of her coat collar. Soft rim light from a hanging lantern behind her.

panels.label: Single-character close-up — Anya, intense emotion
panels.prompt: Tight close-up on Anya's face, jaw clenched, brows drawn together in cold fury. A single tear traces the line of her scar. Lantern light catches one side of her face; the other half drops into shadow.

panels.label: Two-character conversation — mid-shot
panels.prompt: Mid-shot inside the tavern. Anya stands at left, half-turned toward Rurik who leans across the bar at right. Anya's posture is defensive, hand near her belt. Rurik is relaxed, smirking, a tankard of dark ale in his hand. Behind them, blurred patrons in the booths. Warm tungsten light from above.

panels.label: Action panel — Anya drawing blade
panels.prompt: Action shot, slight motion blur. Anya in mid-motion drawing a short blade from her belt with her right hand, body twisting. A stool kicks back behind her. Her coat tail flares. Dramatic low angle, dynamic composition. Spray of beer mist in the air from a knocked-over tankard.

panels.label: Group shot — three figures in standoff
panels.prompt: Three-character composition. Anya at left with blade drawn, Rurik centre with arms raised in a mocking surrender, and a third unnamed mercenary at right (greasy hair, crossbow already half-drawn). All three frozen in the moment before violence. Other tavern patrons scrambling away behind them, blurred. Wide mid-shot.

panels.label: Interior with prop interaction
panels.prompt: Anya seated at a wooden table, examining a folded letter held in both hands. Sealing wax already broken. An overturned ink pot has bled black across the tabletop, reaching the edge of the parchment. A guttering candle in a brass holder. Tight overhead lighting, deep shadow under the table.

panels.label: Reaction shot — Rurik, different character
panels.prompt: Close-up reaction shot of Rurik. His smirk has fallen, eyes wide, pupils dilated, beads of sweat on his bald forehead. A faint reflection of an unseen blade catches the lantern light in his iris. Dark backdrop with one shaft of warm light.
